provider_visible_contract: Module registry and core capability manifests expose bounded identity, capability, resource, authority, validation, provenance, and inspect-only lifecycle metadata.
The pending-review file/git module declares existing filesystem and Git operations with exact source and resource authority and no provider-tool expansion.
The pending-review jobs/program-execution module declares supervised execution, bounded output custody, cancellation, cleanup, and exact resource authority.
The pending-review memory module declares deterministic retrieval, prompt-inclusion decisions, retention evidence, exact resource authority, and no hidden prompt mutation.
The pending-review procedural module declares metadata-only definitions and reviewed activation decisions without hook firing, prompt injection, or repo-managed skills.
The pending-review research module declares metadata-only request, review, and source custody with exact authority and no network or browser execution.
The pending-review notification module declares server-owned device, notification, and delivery resources without enabling live APNs transport or a local inbox.
The pending-review import/update module declares bounded metadata resources, approval and rollback gates, and no deploy, mutation, installer, restart, or network behavior.
